comparisons.peer_summary: The income tax benefit decreased to $7.6 billion in 2024 from $8.4 billion in 2023, primarily due to the absence of benefits recorded against pretax charges in 2023 for the FDIC special assessment and the impact of BSBY's cessation.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and BAC disclose specific drivers behind their 2024 income tax results, citing settlements and structural changes. JPM attributes its expense to 'benefits related to tax audit settlements,' while BAC attributes its decrease in tax benefit primarily to the 'absence of benefits recorded against pretax charges in 2023 for the FDIC special assessment' and the cessation of BSBY.

sentences.text: The current period income tax expense was driven by changes in the level and mix of income and expenses subject to U.S. federal and state and local taxes, including the impact of the net gain on Visa shares and the contribution of Visa shares to the JPMorgan Chase Foundation recorded in the second quarter of 2024, partially offset by benefits related to tax audit settlements.
The decrease in the income tax benefit was primarily due to the benefits recorded against pretax charges in 2023 for the FDIC special assessment and the impact of BSBY's cessation.

peer_results.rationale: Candidates discuss income tax benefits only as a driver of segment net loss (All Other), not as the primary disclosure of income tax expense drivers for the consolidated entity.

comparisons.peer_summary: The effective income tax rate increased to 22.4% in 2024 from 20.7% in 2023, primarily driven by a decrease in the impact of permanent tax benefits, partially offset by changes in the geographic mix of earnings.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and GS explain the variance in their 2024 income tax metrics relative to 2023 by referencing changes in the composition of earnings and permanent tax items. JPM highlights 'changes in the level and mix of taxable income and expenses' including specific events like the Visa gain, whereas GS cites a 'decrease in the impact of permanent tax benefits' and 'changes in the geographic mix of earnings.'

sentences.text: The current period income tax expense was driven by changes in the level and mix of income and expenses subject to U.S. federal and state and local taxes, including the impact of the net gain on Visa shares and the contribution of Visa shares to the JPMorgan Chase Foundation recorded in the second quarter of 2024, partially offset by benefits related to tax audit settlements.

The effective income tax rate for 2024 was 22.4%, up from the full year income tax rate of 20.7% for 2023, primarily due to a decrease in the impact of permanent tax benefits for 2024 compared with 2023, partially offset by changes in the geographic mix of earnings.
